gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Revalia strides across the line with widely separated letters and a g whose lower curve stays open, loud and loose. Its strongest quality is that swagger.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikaku: Expressive Revalia leans on a relaxed stride and a tall band of letters with short stalks above. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui is the quieter half, a sans-serif with daylight in every curve.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Noto Sans Meroitic is friendly and see-through, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Revalia's loose, bold display letters take the big sizes, while this body would sit comfortably a few steps smaller.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mono: Sturdy, generously spaced letters that never bump together make Noto Sans Mono read with real presence. Noto Sans Mono holds that steady ground while Revalia's bold, open-bottomed g swaggers above it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-mro: Revalia's lowercase g leaves its lower curve open. Noto Sans Mro, a plain sans, packs dense, tall-middled words with large entrances into each letter, so a long passage reads brisk and steady beneath that loose heading.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-multani: Noto Sans Multani reads lofty and open, with an e whose terminal leaves a wide gap. Revalia then adds bold, widely spaced display letters on top, so the plain sans body and the showy heading each keep their own space.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Bold Revalia stretches its letters wide, with a tall band and short stalks above. Noto Sans Myanmar, a sans-serif with a heavy-looking strip of text and a welcoming c, counters it, and Revalia earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Revalia's most distinctive habit is its relaxed stride, with widely separated letters and an open-curved g. Noto Sans Nabataean, a sans-serif with wide-open s curves and near cap-tall lowercase, reads smoothly beneath it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Contemporary Noto Sans Nag Mundari has c and s shapes that look half unwrapped, with lowercase rivaling the capitals. And Revalia brings bold, expressive width, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Approachable Noto Sans Nandinagari offers a big lowercase body with short ascenders and generous openings at every weight. And Revalia's loose, bold display stride gives the pair its strongest quality, a lively tension.
